meta.scope: Argentina batch 5 — External trade, export complexes (agro-industrial core), agricultural statistics anchors, and public-sector / government accounts + basic justice/security statistical presence. Continues expanding the developed core.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade Statistics
candidates.publisher: INDEC — Dirección Nacional de Estadísticas del Sector Externo y Cuentas Internacionales
candidates.description: Monthly and annual statistics of Argentine exports and imports of goods, by large rubrics (primary products, MOA, MOI, fuels & energy), by country/region, and with price and quantity indices.
candidates.notes: Core external-trade product. 2025 total goods exports USD 87.1 billion (+9.3% y/y, driven by volumes). Regular monthly tables by large rubric and destination. Direct input into the balance of payments and national accounts.

candidates.title: Complejos exportadores / Export complexes ranking
candidates.description: Analytical grouping of exports into productive complexes (soya, oil-petrochemical, automotive, maize, gold & silver, beef & leather, wheat, sunflower, fisheries, dairy, etc.). Regular ranking of participation and growth.
candidates.notes: High-value analytical product. 2025: soya complex alone 24.6% of total goods exports (USD 21.4 bn); top 10 complexes ~78% of total. Makes the agro-industrial backbone of Argentine trade statistically visible.

candidates.title: Censo Nacional Agropecuario / National Agricultural Census
candidates.description: Structural agricultural census (most recent major round 2018 with subsequent updates and related surveys). Provides the farm-structure baseline, land use, livestock and production characteristics.
candidates.notes: Foundational agricultural statistical product. Continuously cited by agricultural production estimates, export-complex analysis and provincial agricultural offices. Complements the high-frequency trade and production series.

candidates.title: Estimaciones agrícolas / Agricultural production estimates
candidates.publisher: INDEC / Secretaría de Agricultura (joint statistical production)
candidates.description: Regular estimates of area, yield and production for major crops (soya, maize, wheat, sunflower, etc.). High-frequency input into export and activity analysis.
candidates.notes: Operational agricultural statistics that feed both the trade complexes and the monthly activity indicators. Critical for a country whose export structure is still heavily agro-industrial.

candidates.title: Origen provincial de las exportaciones (OPEX)
candidates.description: Statistics that attribute merchandise exports to the province of origin. Reveals the geographic distribution of export capacity (Buenos Aires, Santa Fe, Córdoba dominant; rising share of Neuquén via Vaca Muerta).
candidates.notes: Key geographic bridge between national trade statistics and the provincial layer. 2025 ranking still led by Buenos Aires, Santa Fe and Córdoba, with Neuquén rising on energy exports.

candidates.title: Cuentas del sector gobierno general / General government accounts
candidates.publisher: INDEC — Dirección Nacional de Cuentas Nacionales
candidates.description: Institutional-sector accounts for general government (all levels of public administration excluding public enterprises). Covers production, generation, distribution and use of income, and saving.
candidates.notes: Public-sector counterpart to the generation-of-income and institutional-sector accounts. 2024: disposable income of general government ~17.2% of GDP; final consumption ~14.9%; saving ~2.3%.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de empleo en el sector público / Public-sector employment
candidates.description: Statistics on employment in the public administration (centralised and, where available, broader public sector). Used to track the size and composition of the state workforce.
candidates.notes: Complements the EPH (which covers the whole labour market) with a specific public-sector lens. Recent figures have shown significant net reductions in central administration employment since late 2023, with exceptions in Justice and Security.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de seguridad pública y población en centros de detención
candidates.description: Official statistical tables on population held in detention centres (by legal status, type of establishment, sex, age, etc.) and related criminal-process indicators.
candidates.notes: Basic justice/security statistical presence at national level. Less rich than the full CNIJE-style censuses of Mexico, but still a recurring official product that qualifies under the node definition.

candidates.title: Índices de precios y cantidades del comercio exterior
candidates.description: Price and quantity indices for merchandise exports and imports. Allow decomposition of value changes into price and volume components.
candidates.notes: Essential analytical companion to the value-based trade statistics. 2025 export growth was volume-driven (+10%) while prices edged down (−0.6%).

candidates.title: Manufacturas de Origen Agropecuario (MOA) y Manufacturas de Origen Industrial (MOI)
candidates.description: The two major manufactured-export categories used in Argentine trade statistics: agro-based manufactures (MOA) and industrial manufactures (MOI). Regularly tabulated alongside primary products and fuels.
candidates.notes: Structural classification that makes the dual character of Argentine exports (agro-industrial + industrial) statistically legible. MOA and MOI together still account for the majority of export value in most periods.

proposed_edges.basis: Merchandise trade statistics are a primary input into the goods account of the balance of payments.
Export complexes are an analytical regrouping of the merchandise trade data.
Provincial origin statistics are a geographic attribution of the national trade figures.
General-government accounts are an institutional-sector component of the national accounts.
Price and quantity indices decompose the value changes reported in the trade statistics.
MOA and MOI are the standard large-rubric classification used in the monthly and annual trade releases.
Structural census provides the baseline and sampling frame for ongoing agricultural production estimates.
